scope: Independent feeding safety and evidence-directness triage; no nutrition database or generated page edits
method: Manual review of currently published verdict, rationale, evidence identifiers and scope caveats; no new primary-source validation claimed

records.issue: The assessment itself says no direct tortoise feeding evidence; cell genotoxicity and leaf chemistry do not establish a positive feeding recommendation.
records.review_gate: Check whether a specialist tortoise-feeding source supports even occasional use. If not, distinguish unverified suitability from permitted supplementation.
records.do_not_infer: Non-genotoxicity in cell assays means oral safety in tortoises.

records.issue: Cited veterinary toxicology source reportedly calls the plant unsuitable as feed, but the verdict permits occasional supplementation without tortoise feeding evidence.
records.review_gate: Verify original Vetpharm wording and applicability; determine whether cautious non-recommendation is more faithful than a positive C grade.
records.do_not_infer: Not classified as poisonous means suitable for planned feeding.

records.issue: Ginkgolic acids are identified in leaves, while the supporting study is composition rather than tortoise oral safety evidence.
records.review_gate: Verify the specialist feeding guidance and any relevant species/part-specific hazard data before affirming a positive grade.
records.do_not_infer: Detection of ginkgolic acid proves tortoise toxicity or provides a safe dose.

records.issue: Leaf extract cell effects are not equivalent to consumption of fresh leaves; part-specific source verification is necessary.
records.review_gate: Confirm specialist source addresses fresh leaves, and explicitly exclude seeds/pits and unrelated plant parts.
records.do_not_infer: Extract toxicity determines a safe or toxic feeding dose.

records.issue: Genus-level advice and saponin concerns lack species-specific tortoise dose-response evidence.
records.review_gate: Check whether genus-level advice applies to identifiable species and specific parts.
records.do_not_infer: All Hosta species and parts share identical safety.

records.issue: Family-level Solanaceae caution is not evidence of Petunia toxicity or oral safety.
records.review_gate: Keep the distinction between taxonomic precaution and direct tortoise feeding evidence.

editorial_policy: Never promote an ingredient from unknown to positive feeding status solely because no toxicity case is reported.
Distinguish chemical composition, extracts, cell studies and non-tortoise toxicology from direct oral feeding evidence.
Record taxon and edible plant part before applying a verdict.
Do not change public grades without source-level verification and an accompanying user-facing explanation.
handoff: Claude owns nutrition mapping and page generation; this queue is for independent feeding-evidence adjudication.

evidence_hierarchy: Direct tortoise feeding or veterinary clinical evidence for identified taxon and part
Tortoise specialist plant feeding guidance with explicit part and caveats
Other reptile oral evidence with transferability caveats
Plant chemical composition, extracts, in vitro studies: contextual only
decision_rules: Absence of documented poisoning is not evidence of suitability for planned feeding.
A positive limited-feeding verdict requires affirmative feeding support; composition alone does not suffice.
Do not automatically translate mammalian toxicity or cell results into tortoise toxic doses.
When the source addresses a genus, do not assert species-wide equivalence without review.
Record and disclose contradictions between specialist feeding sources and analytical studies.
review_protocol.adjudication_state: Pending independent source-level verification; no grade changes authorized by this queue

cross_domain_safeguards.purpose: Prevent nutrition species splitting from silently inheriting feeding safety verdicts
applies_to: Mentha spp. → Mentha × piperita / Mentha spicata
requirements: A nutrition taxon split does not establish tortoise feeding safety.
Keep existing genus-level feeding assessment unchanged unless independently reviewed.
New species-level feeding assessment must have its own source-to-species and source-to-plant-part linkage.
Never copy a genus-level positive grade to a species-level record solely because nutrient data exists.
Species-level nutrient evidence can coexist with a feeding assessment that remains unresolved.
cross_domain_safeguards.status: Editorial guardrail only; not a generated-page or nutrition-schema change
